name: supchains
description: Demand planning, demand forecasting, S&OP and inventory planning advice from SupChains and Nicolas Vandeput: the 13 practices of the SupChains Way and the 16 articles behind them.

interface.longDescription:
The SupChains Way is the method SupChains applies on every demand planning and inventory planning project. It holds 13 practices and the 16 articles behind them, written by Nicolas Vandeput. Nicolas is the author of Demand Forecasting Best Practices, Data Science for Supply Chain Forecasting and Inventory Optimization: Models and Simulations. He also organized VN1 and VN2, two open forecasting and inventory competitions on real retail data.

Ask about forecast accuracy and KPIs, MAPE, bias, Forecast Value Added (FVA), machine learning forecasting, forecast changes by planners, S&OP, working with sales and finance, ABC/XYZ segmentation, outliers, safety stock, service levels and inventory simulation.

Every answer takes a clear position, gives the reason, and links the source article on supchains.com.

Your questions stay in ChatGPT: SupChains receives nothing.
capabilities: Forecast KPIs and Forecast Value Added
Demand planning and S&OP process advice
Safety stock and service level advice
defaultPrompt: Should I use MAPE to measure my forecasts?
How should I set safety stock for 5,000 products?
Do my planners' forecast changes add value?
